harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), installed busybox-extras to get an httpd applet, populated /srv/localrepo/x86_64 with tree-2.2.1-r0.apk (fetched with deps) and an apk index, then served it via `busybox-extras httpd -p 8080`. Simulated remote-repo unreachability by mapping dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org to 127.0.0.1 in /etc/hosts (confirmed apk update failed with Connection refused against both remote repos), then successfully installed `tree` via `apk add --repository http://10.100.52.10:8080 --allow-untrusted tree` while remote was unreachable. Reverted /etc/hosts and confirmed remote reachability restored. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and running local repo/httpd state, rebooted node1 natively, polled until it came back, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified tree remained installed and the local repo/httpd could be brought back up and served correctly (HTTP 200) after restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/network/apk config
Installed busybox-extras for the httpd applet
Fetched tree package + deps into /srv/localrepo/x86_64 and built APKINDEX with apk index
Served the local repo via busybox-extras httpd on port 8080
Captured healthy baseline (tree not installed, jq already installed check, remote repos reachable)
Blocked dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org via /etc/hosts to simulate remote-unreachable
Verified apk update fails against remote repos (Connection refused)
Installed tree from the local HTTP repo with --allow-untrusted while remote was unreachable
Verified tree binary works and is registered installed
Restored /etc/hosts and confirmed remote repo reachability recovered
Captured pre-restart boot_id and local repo/httpd health baseline
Rebooted node1 via native reboot, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was available again
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified tree package persisted and local repo files intact after reboot
Restarted the local repo httpd and confirmed it serves the index again (HTTP 200) post-restart

evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: busybox-extras httpd installed and started serving /srv/localrepo (containing tree-2.2.1-r0.apk + deps and a built APKINDEX.tar.gz) on 10.100.52.10:8080, verified with HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: Remote repositories confirmed unreachable before local install
evidence.summary: /etc/hosts redirected dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org to 127.0.0.1; curl got connection refused (exit 7) and apk update reported 'Connection refused' for both main and community remote repos

evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo while remote unreachable
evidence.summary: apk add --repository http://10.100.52.10:8080 --allow-untrusted tree succeeded (OK: 190.0 MiB in 135 packages); tree --version and apk info -e tree confirm functional install, all while remote CDN was unreachable

evidence.requirement: Reversibility: remote reachability restored after test
evidence.summary: /etc/hosts restored from backup; curl to dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org returned 200 and apk update succeeded against remote repos again
Captured boot_id c30a625a-ed6e-45f6-83ec-ffff6a5d222e, confirmed httpd process running, local repo index reachable (HTTP 200), and tree installed prior to reboot
Backgrounded reboot command returned 'reboot scheduled' before disconnect; subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset/timeout, confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id read as 096fd12c-bb3f-432e-81ed-bff722c8633b, differing from the pre-restart 'c30a625a-...' baseline, with a fresh uptime -s timestamp

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of installed package and local repo data
evidence.summary: After reboot, tree remained installed and functional, local repo files were intact on disk, and restarting httpd successfully re-served the local repo (HTTP 200), confirming full recovery
